name: false_movers
command: uv run python tools/false_mover_audit.py --survey-every 4 --baseline-engine DIR --baseline-label "engine at d871490 (before this audit's fixes)"
notes: Truth from Gaia DR3 (IRSA mirror): the Gaia star (G <= 19.5) under every pass position, moved to that pass's date. static: under 0.05"/yr; real_mover: over 0.5"/yr and 3x the SPHEREx error.

cause is set for every mover Gaia shows static, and for an unsettled one only when its pixels show a problem (saturated halo, frame edge, flagged pixels, wavelength-dependent centroid, hopping between Gaia stars).
near_movers: tracks in 3+ passes at >= 5 sigma but under the 1 px bar; not movers today, but a longer baseline would make the fake ones fake movers.

fast_stars: every visible Gaia star (G <= 19.5) moving > 0.5"/yr by at least a pixel over the run, and how the engine tracked it (mover, split into several tracks, one track not flagged, unlinked, missed).
